title: Clawd X Digest
summary: AI Autonomous Tools & Agentic Frameworks: Open-source ecosystem expands with Nous Research integrating Browser Use CLI 3.0 into Hermes, while Mirage announces the launch of an all-AI 24/7 news channel.
Fintech Launches & Financial Infrastructure: X Money unveils the official 𝕏 Card featuring cash back and global zero-fee ATM access, alongside market coverage of emerging market currency trends.
Research Curation & Formal Proof Systems: Developers launch AI pre-print scanning tools for Arxiv filtering 500+ daily papers while open formal proof projects leverage Lean 4 for quantum physics.
Developer Workflows & Testing Automation: AI testing agents gain traction for replacing complex Playwright E2E test suites with natural language browser test execution.
Culture & Entertainment Spotlights: Film retrospectives highlight iconic Hollywood behind-the-scenes stories from Steven Spielberg classics to viral movie production moments.
